deficits.evidence: footway is under 1m and partly blocked by obstructions
deficits.suggestion: Install a continuous, usable sidewalk at least 1m wide along the right side of the road.

deficits.evidence: footway is partly blocked by parked vehicles and stalls
deficits.suggestion: Remove obstructions from the footway to ensure it is fully accessible for pedestrians.

deficits.evidence: uneven sections and trip hazards on the footway

deficits.evidence: 4_or_more lanes with no refuge on the crossing
deficits.suggestion: Add a refuge island in the middle of the road to provide a safe waiting area for pedestrians crossing wide roads.
